code='''from collections import deque, Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for ny,nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            comps.append((color,cells))
    # The L-shaped border component indicates the corner opposite the object to recolor.
    marker = None
    for color,cells in comps:
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        touches_top=min(rs)==0; touches_bottom=max(rs)==h-1
        touches_left=min(cs)==0; touches_right=max(cs)==w-1
        if (touches_top or touches_bottom) and (touches_left or touches_right):
            marker=(color,cells)
            break
    if marker is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    marker_color, mcells = marker
    mr=sum(r for r,c in mcells)/len(mcells); mc=sum(c for r,c in mcells)/len(mcells)
    target_r = h-1 if mr < h/2 else 0
    target_c = w-1 if mc < w/2 else 0
    # An isolated color pixel, when present, specifies the paint color; otherwise use the L color.
    paint = marker_color
    singles=[(color,cells) for color,cells in comps if len(cells)==1 and color != marker_color]
    if singles:
        paint=singles[0][0]
    candidates=[]
    for color,cells in comps:
        if color == marker_color or (len(cells)==1 and color==paint):
            continue
        cr=sum(r for r,c in cells)/len(cells); cc=sum(c for r,c in cells)/len(cells)
        # Select a component lying in the diagonally opposite quadrant.
        if ((cr >= h/2) == (target_r == h-1)) and ((cc >= w/2) == (target_c == w-1)):
            dist=abs(cr-target_r)+abs(cc-target_c)
            candidates.append((dist,color,cells))
    if not candidates:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _,_,cells=min(candidates,key=lambda item:item[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=paint
    return out
'''

    options=[(gap(cells),cells) for col,cells in comps if cells is not mcells]
